rules: For EVERY sentence write 12 alternative wordings (English). Each wording states exactly the same fact: keep every figure, amount, period, percentage and every name listed in keep_figures / keep_names exactly as written. Do not add a figure, a condition or a claim; do not drop one. The wordings must differ in construction (subject, order of the clauses, voice, sentence type), not by swapping single words: no run of 6 words in a row may be shared with the original or with another wording of the same sentence. About the same length as the original (0.6x to 1.6x). Neutral editorial third person, no em dashes, no semicolons, no second person.
